targeting: R-BODY-2 build grounding + post-deletion (R-SHARING/R-LEGION/R-BODY-1) landscape rules

notes.abstract_slice: Pre-encoder covariate admission as an input-side interface: lightweight representation-level gate with sigmoid scores (+ usage-regularized variant penalizing average admission). Plug-in for TimeXer, iTransformer, PatchTST under zero-extra-tuning protocol (gated model inherits baseline config).
notes.design_point: R-BODY-2 must include a gated-admission CONTROL arm, not just body-swap-vs-stock: admission interface may carry what the body does not. Zero-extra-tuning protocol adopted for any R-BODY-2 gate (inherit baseline config, no per-arm tuning).
notes.relevance: Admission interface over architecture. Converges with our simplification arc: regulate what enters the encoder before rebuilding the encoder.
notes.title: A Lightweight Plug-in Gate for Transformer-Based Time-Series Forecasters

notes.abstract_slice: Five families (DLinear, LSTM, PatchTST, ResAttLstm, Mamba2) x nine context lengths on single-buoy Hs, re-evaluated on 47-buoy 37-year corpus: families converge to a common level (between-family SD 0.0014 m^2, 0.8% of grand mean); cross-dataset shift (4.83x MSE) dwarfs architecture spread. No architecture consistently wins. Deep models underperform persistence on the most extreme 1%.
notes.design_point: FAMILY-INDIFFERENCE RULE for R-BODY-2: channel-independent (univariate-per-channel, the PatchTST shape) families converge with everything else — R-BODY-2 lives or dies ONLY by the P1 carry bar, never by family prestige. Extremes-fail note: our skill metric must keep reporting tail behavior, not just means.
notes.relevance: Direct constraint on R-BODY-2 expectations. Architecture choice will not save a non-carrying shell.
notes.title: On the Limits of Univariate Deep Learning for Significant Wave Height Forecasting

notes.abstract_slice: Freeze a base forecaster to construct retrieval keys; turn its historical forecast RESIDUALS into train-only memory specific to that base model. At inference, retrieve residual trajectories from similar historical contexts for feedback correction. Retains individual historical residual examples as inference-time memory instead of using residuals only for optimization/diagnosis.
notes.design_point: LIVE MEMORY DIRECTION post-R-SHARING-delete: internalize residuals (train-only memory keyed by a frozen base), never share protos between members. Any future memory proposal is residual-shaped and member-local, or it does not ship.
notes.relevance: The literature-side successor to our deleted donor-transfer machinery. Converges with MEMTS (11o, parameterize-don't-share) from the retrieval side.
notes.title: RATL: Learning from Retrieved Residuals for Robust Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting

notes.abstract_slice: Generalized differencing with LEARNABLE weights (weighted differencing over previous instants), stabilized residuals for forecasting, removed components restored autoregressively — trend + seasonality through a single operation. Classical differencing stayed out of deep architectures because orders/periods were hand-picked.
notes.design_point: DORMANT P2 FOLLOW-UP (P2 stays SET-STANDS): if the pipeline ever re-opens, the first new arm is learnable-differencing, never another hand-picked order/period. No action now.
notes.relevance: Upgrades the P2 differenced-arm concept without reopening P2.
notes.title: Learning to Difference: Adaptive Reversible Differencing (AdaRDiff) for Time Series Forecasting

notes.abstract_slice: Leakage-free streaming protocol, six public multivariate streams. Two comparison biases: (1) static-baseline warmup budget is two-sided — undertrains or degrades pre-drift generalization; adaptation benefit swings 3.0-18.8pp over 1k-20k warmup range. (2) SGD+m vs Adam at a shared default LR conflates optimizer quality with rate sensitivity. Fix warmup + per-optimizer rates on held-out pre-drift data.
notes.design_point: PROBE-DISCIPLINE RULE (hardened): every future adaptation/train comparison pre-registers warmup budget + per-arm rates, fixed before the comparison. Applies to R-BODY-2 gates and any TODO-97 trigger work. Our m5g fixed-seed/fresh-mind convention already satisfies the leakage half; this closes the warmup/rate half.
notes.relevance: Evaluation hygiene for all future gates. Directly supports TODO-97 trigger design (realized-error dynamics, not drift alarms).
notes.title: When Does Online Adaptation Pay on the Edge? A Leakage-Free Evaluation of Warmup, Learning-Rate Selection, and Resource Trade-offs for Time-Series Forecasting

notes.abstract_slice: Fat-tailed financial returns (S&P 500 monthly log-returns 1871-2023, anchored walk-forward): output heads form a strict gradient (point -> Gaussian ~1.3% CRPS, Gaussian -> 4-mixture ~+2.4%); backbone switches move CRPS <1.5% on the point row. Head gradient (3.7pp) dominates backbone spread.
notes.design_point: READOUT-OVER-BODY RULE (financial returns): post-R-BODY-1-death, the higher-EV direction is the readout/head, not another body. B3 readout instrument stays PARKED with its ordered gate — this paper is entered as supporting evidence for its unpark priority over any future body proposal.
notes.relevance: Independent vindication of the P1b DEAD verdict from the finance side: backbones do not move financial returns; heads do.
notes.title: Heads, Not Backbones: Output Heads Dominate Architectures on Fat-Tailed Returns

notes.abstract_slice: 6.5M-parameter forecaster competes with 31x models (TimesFM 200M) after training-pipeline fixes ONLY, no architecture change: corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, wider augmentation -> MASE 3.030 to 1.704 (-43.8%) same data/compute. Beats TimesFM on all ETT sets + exchange rate; beats PatchTST (15M+) on all ETT.
notes.design_point: PIPELINE-AUDIT-FIRST RULE (hardened, precedes R-BODY-2): before any new-body code, audit loss scope + tensor-shape alignment + augmentation coverage on the CURRENT body. 43.8% from pipeline fixes dwarfs any body-swap expectation (cf. family-indifference above). R-BODY-2 build opens with this audit, recorded as its step zero.
notes.relevance: Training pipeline dominates architecture. Mandatory step zero for R-BODY-2.
notes.title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
